citations.cites: E-15 exclusion – flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, or overflow of any body of water

facts: Water pooled on the patio and ran in under the patio door into the family room after a thunderstorm on 11 August 2024.
Carpets and skirting boards soaked; estimated loss $4,800.
note: The loss involves surface water entering the residence, which matches the definition of "Surface water" (HO-0304_03-24#02) and triggers the E-15 exclusion for flood and surface water (HO-0304_03-24#05). [HO-0304_03-24#02] [HO-0304_03-24#05]
